input.ticket: Customer says a $2,400 charge to 'GLOBAL VEND LTD' isn't theirs. They want an immediate dispute opened and provisional credit applied to their balance.

expected.resolution: Confirm unrecognized merchant on account under 90 days old (42 days) with charge exceeding $100. Escalate immediately to Fraud Investigation queue before taking money-moving dispute actions.

input.ticket: Our card was charged $185.00 by 'SAAS METRICS CLOUD' yesterday. We never signed up for this software. Please cancel it and reverse the money immediately.

expected.resolution: Account ACC-0002 has an active 'recent_chargeback' risk flag. Under fraud thresholds policy, any disputed charge exceeding $50 on an account with risk flags requires mandatory escalation to Fraud before filing.

input.ticket: We noticed an unauthorized high-value charge of $4,500 to 'APEX CAPITAL HARDWARE' on our corporate card. Please file a dispute and credit our credit line immediately.

expected.resolution: Even on mature enterprise accounts, any disputed charge exceeding $1,000 requires mandatory senior fraud review. Escalate to fraud queue without unilateral ledger adjustment.

input.ticket: We are hitting our $5,000 limit due to a major marketing push. Your website says accounts in good standing can get a 10% automated limit bump. Please raise our credit limit to $5,500 today.

expected.resolution: Account ACC-0004 is only 55 days old. While product docs mention a 10% bump, underwriting policy explicitly prohibits autonomous limit adjustments on accounts under 180 days. Must escalate to underwriting.

input.ticket: There is a $320 charge from 'UNKNOWN DIGITAL TECH' that our team did not authorize. We need this disputed right now.

expected.resolution: Account ACC-0005 has an active 'ip_country_mismatch' risk flag. Any dispute above $50 on an account with risk flags requires mandatory escalation to Fraud.

input.ticket: Due to your platform latency during month-end close, our accounting team spent hours reconciling invoices. We demand a goodwill courtesy refund of $120.00 to cover our inconvenience.

expected.resolution: Tier 2 support agents only have discretionary refund authority up to $50.00. Any goodwill refund exceeding $50 requires escalation to Finance.

input.ticket: We are expanding our fleet and need our credit limit adjusted from $60,000 to $66,000 immediately. We are an Enterprise tier account in good standing.

expected.resolution: Account ACC-0007 has active 'rapid_spend_velocity' flag and requested limit exceeds $50,000. Underwriting policy strictly prohibits autonomous agent limit increases. Escalate to Underwriting.

input.ticket: Our VP's card has been compromised! We see several strange transactions totaling over $800. Please cancel the card and issue credits for all these charges immediately.

expected.resolution: Deactivate and replace the compromised card immediately via replace_card. Because fraudulent charges exceed $500 and account has active risk flags, escalate dispute resolution to Fraud queue.

input.ticket: We received an unexpected charge on our account. Can you help us reverse it?

expected.resolution: The ticket is underspecified (no merchant, amount, or transaction ID provided). Retrieve account context and ask customer for specific transaction details before taking any action.

input.ticket: Why is our account showing restricted? We uploaded our business license last week.

expected.resolution: Account ACC-0010 has an 'ip_country_mismatch' flag alongside restricted KYC status. Reconciling general KYC policy with heightened due diligence: must request utility bill proof of physical address and route to Compliance.

input.ticket: I see a charge of $42.50 to 'UBER TECHNOLOGIES' that says 'Pending' for 3 days. Can you dispute this pending charge for me?

expected.resolution: Explain per settlement rails policy that pending authorizations cannot be formally disputed until merchant batch clearing/settlement completes (24-48 hours), or authorization hold expires.

input.ticket: We sent a wire transfer 2 hours ago to a vendor, but just realized the routing number was wrong. Can you cancel the wire and return our funds?

expected.resolution: Per wire policy, transfers past the 15-minute pre-release window are settled and irrevocable. Escalate to Fraud/Correspondent team to initiate a Fedwire recall request.

input.ticket: I was double charged by Slack Technologies ($120 twice) on the same day. One says settled and one is pending. What should I do?

expected.resolution: Clarify that duplicate pending authorizations typically drop off within 48-72 hours. If both settle, a duplicate dispute can be opened.

input.ticket: Our account manager lost their phone with 2FA authenticator. How do we get them logged back into the admin dashboard?

expected.resolution: Per account security policy, 2FA cannot be disabled directly over chat/email without out-of-band verification. Request identification documents or escalate to security.

input.ticket: We have an annual subscription charge from Notion Labs for $96 that we forgot to cancel. Can Meridian Pay refund this subscription charge for us?

expected.resolution: Explain refund authority: Meridian Pay cannot issue refunds for third-party merchant subscriptions. Customer must contact merchant directly or file dispute if merchant was cancelled prior to renewal.

input.ticket: Can we create virtual cards for contractors outside the US to spend on software subscriptions?

expected.resolution: Explain card overview policy: virtual single-use and multi-use cards can be created by company admins for vendor payments worldwide, but cards must be denominated in USD and subject to account limit.

input.ticket: We sent an ACH transfer to pay off our card balance yesterday morning, but our available limit hasn't updated yet. Why?

expected.resolution: Explain settlement rails: Standard ACH payments take 3-5 business days to clear and credit back to available credit limit unless submitted via Same-Day ACH before 1:00 PM EST cutoff.

input.ticket: Someone created a virtual card on our account yesterday that we don't recognize, but no transactions have happened on it yet.

expected.resolution: Potential credential compromise / unauthorized portal access. Recommend immediate password/2FA reset, revoke session tokens, and route to Security/Fraud queue.

input.ticket: My physical card was bent in my wallet and the chip is no longer reading at terminals. Can I get a replacement?

expected.resolution: Reissue damaged card via replace_card(card_id, reason='damaged'). Inform customer that virtual card remains active in digital wallet while physical card ships via standard 3-5 day transit.

input.ticket: I left my card at a restaurant in Chicago and cannot retrieve it. Please cancel it and send me a new card.

expected.resolution: Immediately block and replace lost card via replace_card(card_id, reason='lost_stolen'). Provide shipping estimate.

input.ticket: We were charged a $25 late payment fee because our ACH was delayed due to a bank holiday. This is our first time in 2 years. Can you please refund this $25 fee?

expected.resolution: Account ACC-0022 is mature (>180 days) with no risk flags. Fee refund of $25 is within agent discretionary authority (<= $50). Issue refund via issue_refund.

input.ticket: We have an unrecognized charge of $35.00 from 'STAPLES SUPPLIES' on our card. Our account has been active for over a year and no one on our team bought this. Can you dispute it?

expected.resolution: Mature account (>90 days), zero risk flags, and amount under $100. Routine dispute eligible for agent action: open dispute via open_dispute.

input.ticket: How do I add my Meridian Pay corporate card to Apple Pay on my iPhone?

expected.resolution: Explain Apple Pay provisioning: navigate to Card Details in Meridian Pay app or dashboard, click 'Add to Apple Wallet', or enter card number directly into Apple Wallet.

input.ticket: What is our current credit limit and available balance on account ACC-0025?

expected.resolution: Retrieve account context via get_account and report credit limit and current balance clearly to customer.

input.ticket: What documents are required to complete our company's KYC verification?

expected.resolution: Provide standard KYC requirements: primary government-issued photo ID of beneficial owner (>25% ownership) and Certificate of Good Standing or Business License. Call request_documents.

input.ticket: Can we set individual spending limits for our sales reps' cards so they can't spend more than $500 a day?

expected.resolution: Confirm that company administrators can customize spending limits per cardholder down to $100/day directly in the card management dashboard.

input.ticket: How long does an international SWIFT wire take to reach a supplier in Germany?

expected.resolution: Explain settlement rails: International SWIFT wires typically take 1 to 3 business days, subject to intermediary banking fees and sanctions screening.

input.ticket: What is the daily cash advance limit on our corporate cards?

expected.resolution: Daily cash advance limit is $500 per card, and requires explicit company administrator permission.

input.ticket: Our physical card was washed in the laundry and doesn't work. Can we get a replacement sent?

expected.resolution: Reissue damaged card via replace_card(card_id, reason='damaged').

input.ticket: What is the deadline for disputing an incorrect charge from our monthly billing statement?

expected.resolution: Per dispute policy and card network regulations, disputes must be initiated within 60 calendar days of the settlement/statement date.

input.ticket: We had an accidental $15 wire statement fee charged to our account during our trial period. Can this be waived?

expected.resolution: Account in good standing. $15 fee is within agent $50 discretionary refund authority. Issue refund via issue_refund.

input.ticket: How do single-use virtual cards work for paying SaaS vendors?

expected.resolution: Explain virtual single-use cards: generated with exact dollar limits and auto-expiration after one authorization to protect against vendor data leaks.

input.ticket: Can we get expedited next-day shipping for our replacement card? We are on the Growth tier.

expected.resolution: Growth tier accounts receive complimentary next business day expedited shipping for replacement cards.

input.ticket: Does Meridian Pay support Same-Day ACH for paying contractors?

expected.resolution: Yes, Same-Day ACH is supported with a daily submission cutoff at 1:00 PM EST, settling by 5:00 PM local time.

input.ticket: Our card was left in a taxi cab overseas. Please disable it and send a replacement to our home office.

expected.resolution: Call replace_card(card_id, reason='lost_stolen') to deactivate card and dispatch replacement.

input.ticket: What are the baseline credit limits for the Starter tier vs Growth tier?

expected.resolution: Starter tier baseline limit is $2,500 - $10,000; Growth tier baseline limit is $10,000 - $50,000.

input.ticket: We have an unrecognized charge of $45.00 from 'FEDEX FREIGHT' on ACC-0025. Account is 185 days old with zero risk flags. Please dispute this charge.

expected.resolution: Mature account with zero risk flags and amount <= $100. Call open_dispute directly without escalation.

input.ticket: How can an employee view their PIN for a physical corporate card?

expected.resolution: Employees can view or reset their card PIN directly within the Meridian Pay mobile app under Card Settings using biometric authentication.

input.ticket: Can we link multiple bank accounts to our Meridian Pay profile for automatic balance payoff?

expected.resolution: Yes, Meridian Pay supports connecting multiple commercial bank accounts via Plaid or micro-deposits for autopay scheduling.

input.ticket: We had a duplicate billing charge of $10 for account maintenance fees. Can this $10 fee be reversed?

expected.resolution: Fee refund <= $50 on account in good standing. Issue refund via issue_refund.

input.ticket: Does Meridian Pay issue corporate cards under the Visa network or Mastercard network?

expected.resolution: Meridian Pay issues commercial cards on both the Visa and Mastercard business networks depending on account configuration.

input.ticket: Our new physical card hasn't arrived yet after 7 business days. Can we check shipping status?

expected.resolution: Provide tracking information and note that standard shipping takes 3-5 days; offer to reissue if lost in transit.

input.ticket: What does return code R01 mean on our failed ACH payment?

expected.resolution: Explain return code R01: Insufficient Funds in the originating bank account.

input.ticket: Our employee's card was demagnetized at a hotel checkout. Need a replacement physical card.

expected.resolution: Call replace_card(card_id, reason='damaged'). Existing card remains active in digital wallet.

input.ticket: How do we download our monthly transaction statement in CSV or PDF?

expected.resolution: Navigate to the Statements tab in the Meridian Pay dashboard and select desired billing cycle to download CSV or PDF.

input.ticket: Is there any foreign transaction fee when spending in Canadian Dollars with our physical card?

expected.resolution: Meridian Pay corporate cards feature zero foreign transaction fees on international card purchases.

input.ticket: Can we create multi-use virtual cards for our recurring AWS cloud infrastructure bills?

expected.resolution: Yes, virtual multi-use cards are specifically designed for recurring subscriptions like cloud infrastructure with dedicated monthly budget caps.

input.ticket: What is the cutoff time for domestic Fedwire transfers to settle on the same business day?

expected.resolution: Domestic Fedwire transfers must be submitted by 4:00 PM EST for same-day settlement.
